subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Karl Benz and the First Car
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Karl Benz and the First Car.

hook.text: Karl Benz filed a patent for a motorized vehicle in 1886. The world barely noticed.

buildup.text: His Patent-Motorwagen had three wheels, a single cylinder, and a top speed of 10 mph.

discovery.text: Benz wasn't just an inventor—he built the entire car: engine, frame, ignition, and steering.

twist.text: His investors wanted him to focus on stationary engines. Cars seemed like expensive toys.

climax.text: It took Bertha Benz's cross-country drive to prove the car had a future beyond the workshop.

punchline.text: The first carmaker needed his wife to prove his car.

quiz.question: How fast could the first Benz car go?
